title: Failed note creation produces no user-visible result
reproduction: Open Notes as a signed-in user with organization selected.
Make the notes INSERT fail, such as by denying it at the database boundary.
Click New note and observe the settled UI.
expected: The failed create is reported and the user remains in the list with a clear way to retry.
actual: createNote converts a database error into null; NotesList only changes selection when the result is truthy and renders no error or notice for null.
severity: S3: create failure is silent in the Notes surface
priority: P2: user repeats the action or assumes a note was created
verification_status: Original silent-create path failed a focused consumer guard, and the first correction passed 15/15 tests and compile. Final uncertainty wording, refresh action, and editor-selection ordering await a guarded rerun after resource pressure refused admission; native acceptance pending.
current_source_truth: A null or thrown create result now shows an uncertain-result notice with Refresh notes and Retry creating note. A confirmed returned note selects its editor before refreshing the list. This final correction has not yet passed a post-change guarded test or compile.

transition_history.reason: Concrete source branch and self-contained reproduction identified; runtime pending.

Visible create failure and retry source implemented; peer found and corrected misleading certainty and post-insert editor ordering. Final guarded checks refused by unsafe memory pressure before launch and remain outstanding.
